title: Workspace add-on toggles: configurable observability retention + compliance gating with contract questionnaire
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Run a controlled experiment to introduce per-workspace opt-in toggles for three enterprise add-ons: extended observability retention tiers, a Compliance Pack (SSO/SAML + audit logs + KMS integrations), and a Premium SLA offering. The goal is to validate demand, price elasticity, and the minimal contract / security questionnaire flow required to enable gated features without causing friction for start-up customers. Key constraints: keep the default experience unchanged for existing free/trial users; ensure legal & security gating for Compliance Pack and Premium SLA before activation.
hypothesis: If we expose clear opt-in add-on toggles in the Console with transparent pricing and a lightweight contract/questionnaire flow for Compliance and SLA, >8% of eligible demo/paid workspaces will opt into one or more add-ons in the pilot and ARR impact will be measurable within 90 days.
scope: Console UI: add-ons page with toggle, price tooltip, and activation CTA
Backend: entitlement flags, billing integration, and enforcement at request-time
Security: questionnaire flow for Compliance Pack and SLA that routes to sales/legal when needed
Telemetry: track conversions, time-to-activation, churn signals, and latency/cost impact
out_of_scope: Full contract negotiation for large enterprise (we'll route to sales)
Deep integration work for on-prem/private installers (pilot only covers hosted + Dedicated)
acceptance_criteria: Console shows toggles and price breakdown for each add-on
Enabling an add-on sets entitlement flags and updates billing immediately
Compliance Pack activation requires questionnaire completion; if answers trigger manual review, status = Pending Review
Premium SLA activation shows required contract terms and routes to sales for >$X commit
Pilot telemetry shows per-addon conversion rate, average MRR uplift, and impact on token cost under typical workloads

risks: Confusing UI leads to accidental opt-ins and billing surprise
Questionnaire gating adds latency to activation and may frustrate customers
Billing integration edge-cases could allow access without entitlement enforcement
Sales funnel leak: customers routed to manual review may churn if SLA/Compliance buys are slow
rollback_plan: Immediately flip console feature flag to hide add-on toggles and revoke newly minted entitlements. Billing reversals handled by RevOps with pro-rated credits. Notify pilot customers and offer manual remediation. Postmortem within 5 business days.
rollout_plan: Start with a 12-customer pilot (mix of mid-market and enterprise) for 30 days, collect quantitative metrics and qualitative feedback, iterate on UI and questionnaire. If conversion >=8% and no major security/legal blockers, expand to all paid workspaces behind feature flag for 60 days before GA.
metrics: Conversion rate (workspaces that opt into at least one add-on)
Average MRR uplift per activated workspace
Time from click-to-activation for each add-on
Number of manual reviews triggered by questionnaire
Impact on token-level latency and per-token cost for observability retention
Support tickets and churn rate among pilot customers
